node: AI cluster networking, Ethernet/InfiniBand, optical modules, fiber and silicon photonics
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI cluster networking/optics node identifies five US-listed companies with direct or second-order exposure to the networking chokepoint: Ethernet switch silicon and NICs, cloud/AI Ethernet switching systems, optical DSP/interconnect silicon, 800G/1.6T optical transceivers and lasers, and dense fiber/connectivity infrastructure. The strongest evidence is for Broadcom, Arista, Marvell and Coherent from company disclosures tied directly to AI networking, Ethernet, scale-up/scale-out interconnect, 800G/1.6T optics or AI datacenter demand. Corning is included as a second-order infrastructure/materials candidate because dense fiber infrastructure appears increasingly tied to AI datacenter buildouts, but its exposure requires more segment-level revenue verification.
